verdict.rationale: Real-time voice integrations are a fair axis for a memory layer, but the evidence pack names no LiveKit, Pipecat, or ElevenLabs integration and gives no latency figures for live conversation. The '22 tools' integration list names only LangChain, CrewAI, LlamaIndex, and the Vercel AI SDK, so it cannot be credited to this voice-pipeline story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can wire memory into real-time voice pipelines (e.g. LiveKit, Pipecat, ElevenLabs) with documented integrations fast enough for live conversation
